craft_notes: Sthāyin: got-joy. Close: unmade. Rejected: 'prove' for parīkṣya — killed: examined kept; 'absolute' for akṛtrima — killed: unmade kept.

lines: By that effort the examined real is reverently won;
since its freedom is everywhere — unmade, not done.
l4.sanskrit_cite: labhate tatprayatnena parīkṣyaṃ tattvam ādarāt | yataḥ svatantratā tasya sarvatreyam akṛtrimā

reads_against.argmap: By that effort the to-be-examined reality is got respectfully; since its freedom is everywhere unmade.
c1_essence: By effort reality got respectfully; freedom everywhere unmade.
